title: BRICKHAUS - BJJ Performance & Hypertrophy: Full Body 2x Week
author: Jake H.
desc:
The purpose is to gain as much upper body strength and mass, lower body explosive power in such way that is complementary to your BJJ training. 

2x week Full Body workouts AND will give you enough stimulus to grow, while capitalizing recovery. This is assuming you are rolling AT LEAST 3-4x week.

Run this program and your sparring partners will feel like they’re rolling with a Brick Sh*t house.

ex.note: This will build trunk stability along with leg strength. Your arms and back should feel smoked after this.
Dont load up weight here. Focus on explosive power with moderate weight. If you’re power clean form sucks, either do dumbell cleans or hip thrusts.
Hold a weight. Holding it to your chest is easier. Holding behind your head is harder. If you can’t add weight, progress by gradually doing more reps with the plate behind your head.
Just because it’s high reps doesn’t mean you shouldn’t progress in weight. If you’re not adding weight week by week you’re messing up. Start super light the first week.
I find there’s a terrible mind muscle connection with this exercise so don’t worry about. The forearms and grip are priority here. Just work and embrace the burn. Increase weight weekly.
Do 4 each leg. 8 reps total.
Don’t go heavy here. Not like you’d be able to anyway. Focus on good technique to bullet proof your lower back.
